post.description:
Receives and processes PayPal webhooks:
1. Signature verification: Reject unsigned events unless explicit DEV flag is set.
2. Process-then-commit: Transition status PROCESSING -> PROCESSED (or FAILED on error to allow retries).
3. On CUSTOMER.DISPUTE.CREATED: Fetch dispute, draft defense via defense_drafter, route to Control Tower.

post.description:
Execute a full autonomous commerce cycle:
1. Buyer Agent checks spend policy & creates PayPal Orders v2
2. PayPal Sandbox captures payment
3. Merchant Agent pushes courier tracking & anchors Merkle leaf
4. Buyer Agent raises dispute
5. PaySentinel Firewall inspects & merchant agent counters or escalates
